contentList.content: Before you lies a crystal of gigantic proportions that shrinks to the size of a waterskin when picked up. The crystal feels rough to touch and quietly whimpers with astral flares, while inside a gaping violet vortex can be seen drawing light into itself. This interplanar artifact is considered an extremely valuable find, sought after by master artificiers.
Flashes of interplanar disturbance keep bursting from this raw piece of astral ore, burning the eyes of anyone who looks at the stone long enough. Extremely heavy for its size.

A strange octahedron pulses with purple-golden radiance, occasionally emitting whispers in forgotten languages. When touched, it feels simultaneously impossibly cold and scorchingly hot, leaving no physical marks but creating a persistent sensation as if distant minds from unknown Planes are watching you.

You gaze upon this unnervingly smooth crystal, peering into its dark emerald depths—a crystallized fragment of the Astral Plane itself. The Weave thrums powerfully within these astral shards, their surfaces reflecting not light, but thoughts and dreams from the Silver Void. Wizards treasure them for amplifying their arcane experiments without the usual magical backlash, while common folk use them in sacred rituals, believing the crystals carry whispers from departed souls. Yet it was the artificers who truly understood what these crystals could become. Through careful experimentation with prismatic refraction, they learned to draw something more than mere light from the astral shards—something that responds to will rather than incantation. The workshops of Faerûn's enchanters have never been quite the same since.
